frame: x = width left->right, y = depth front(0)->back, z = up (floor = 0). Three.js: use (x, z, -y) for a y-up scene.
note: Each part is a flat plate. Local plate coordinates (a,b); 3D point = origin + a*u + b*v + w*n, w in [0, thickness]. width/height = body size, bbox = full outline incl. tabs. outline = exterior ring in local (a,b) (tabs included, no holes); holes = LIST of interior rings in local (a,b), one per cut-out (joint slots, pilots, vents, handle slots, pockets), same coordinates as the DXF CUT layer; hole_count = len(holes). Render the part as outline minus holes (extrude the shape with holes, or boolean-subtract). See PARTS-SCHEMA.md. sheet = nest sheet number (see plan.json).
